rationale: Rear-end collision with a motor vehicle causing totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at red light; policyholder's vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver insured; information available on police report. Requires urgent adjuster attention due to total loss and injury claim.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle going approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
